result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred insurance limits, includes legally required workers’ compensation, and requires certificates on request. However, the one-year post-termination coverage requirement and coverage for processing any Corio data go beyond the stated playbook and are not necessary to satisfy it. The insertion also creates a duplicate Section 14.10, and the renumbering instruction is unclear and incorrectly refers to a subsequent section. These issues reduce drafting quality, although the existing substantive provisions remain unchanged.
